body.title: Full-surface visual verification across all three states, with evidence committed
body.summary: The whole-surface pass that CONFIRMS rather than discovers, now that t4 and t5 have each already read their own drawing in isolation. Every DOM stub is CSS-blind and geometry-blind, so overlap, clipping, mis-attached edges and arrows pointing nowhere are invisible to every assertion in the suite — and all of them destroy the only thing this Story delivers. Render the real shell with real ledger records, screenshot headless, READ the images back, and commit them under S003/evidence/.
acceptanceChecks: Both REAL erDefinitions (3-class and 8-class) rendered in the mounted surface: boxes do not overlap, every edge visibly connects the two boxes it names, no label is clipped or escapes its box, crow's-foot ends distinguishable — confirmed by READING the image
A REAL sequenceDefinition in the mounted surface: participants and ordered messages legible, order visually unambiguous
The 'unshowable' state: the reason text is legible and the link-out is visibly reachable
The 'absent' state: nothing is drawn and the body renders exactly as it does without the Story
A self-referencing and a cyclic model read back as images and draw sensibly — the shapes most likely to produce a nonsense picture

A document carrying BOTH a diagram ref and a ux-mock ref (the real shape of LLD-bfe98ff7f97178cf-s2) shows the diagram slot only and leaves the experience slot to s4 — s3 must not pre-empt that arrangement
All state images committed under S003/evidence/ at the paths the commit message CLAIMS — verified against the tree, after a wrong-path evidence commit had to be amended in S002
